primary: Expected focal decision loss for one-step decision value minus one-step expected hypothesis information acquisition in the correctly specified finite law.
secondary: Family recovery, posterior mass at true family, expected held-out Brier, prediction regret and out-of-library posterior concentration. No multiplicity claims; no seed or sampling interval because all potential observation vectors are enumerated.
calibration: The query scorers were checked against separate analytic channels in fixtures.json. The held-out truth values or probabilities from the generating state are never passed to acquisition. All trials, including the initial query, are independent Bernoulli conditional on the generating model.
